turns.question: What was the total ad spend in EUR per non-cancelled order placed in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for ad spend per non-cancelled order, so I cannot give that figure. The closest metrics are Ad spend (EUR) (ad_spend_eur) for total spend, and Cost per booking (EUR) and Cost per lead (EUR), which divide spend by bookings or leads rather than by orders; no freshness statement was returned because I did not run query_metrics for this turn.
